source: Clean guard: the fix the CVE write-ups ask for - a stated directory boundary - applied to write tools whose verbs and path parameters otherwise match the write-sink class

tools.name: save_note
tools.description: Save a note to a file. Writes are confined to the workspace directory.

tools.name: export_report
tools.description: Export a report. The output path is restricted to the configured export directory.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file. Paths outside the upload directory are rejected.

tools.name: create_file
tools.description: Create a file at the given path, relative to the sandbox root.
